D_2Mpp.role: real-galaxy redshift-space density and count field

D_CF4_groups.role: canonical grouped distance and radial-velocity marks

D_CF4_individual_galaxies.role: crossmatch bridge from individual entries to canonical CF4 1PGC groups

crossmatch_contract.secure_rule: bidirectional mutual nearest on the unit sphere, separation <= 3.0 arcsec, abs(CF4 Vcmb - 2M++ Vcmb) <= 300 km/s, exact one-to-one
crossmatch_contract.secure_individual_mapping_action: aggregate through CF4 1PGC membership; the group-level CF4 likelihood remains canonical
crossmatch_contract.conflict_and_review_action: quarantine until resolution by a rule frozen before candidate or validation-truth inspection

joint_factorization.target_form: p(IC, nuisance, shared_latents | D_2Mpp, D_CF4_groups) proportional to p(IC) p(nuisance) L_2Mpp_counts(D_2Mpp | F_z0(IC), nuisance, shared_latents) L_CF4_group_marks(D_CF4_groups | F_z0(IC), membership, shared_latents)
joint_factorization.2Mpp_factor: real-galaxy redshift-space density/count likelihood with the declared selection, RSD, luminosity-bias, shot-noise, and model-discrepancy terms
joint_factorization.CF4_factor: group distance/radial-velocity marks conditional on shared redshift and membership latents
joint_factorization.shared_secure_object_rule: one shared redshift datum or latent per securely mapped object, never two independent Vcmb likelihood terms

selection_model_design.tracer_population_definition: Cartesian product of two apparent-magnitude samples and three equal-width absolute-K bins
required_terms: angular completeness evaluated at galaxies and empty-sky locations
sampled mean density for each tracer population

galaxy_bias.form: positive luminosity-dependent nuisance parameters for all six tracer populations

bias_shot_and_model_discrepancy.shot_noise_baseline: Poisson count likelihood after selection thinning
bias_shot_and_model_discrepancy.alternative_selection_rule: freeze on development mocks and assess once on untouched independent validation mocks

redshift_space_distortion_model.method: direct forward prediction from the z=0 velocity posterior
required_components: small-scale FoG or group velocity dispersion
joint treatment of secure CF4 membership and shared redshift latents

posterior_and_frontier_policy.inference_role: direct all-data forward likelihood within the hybrid route

blockers: full angular selection/completeness map at empty-sky positions is absent from the current raw tables
K-correction, evolution-correction, extinction, and luminosity-function contract is incomplete
RSD and FoG/group-dispersion priors are incomplete
luminosity-dependent bias, HOD or overdispersion, and forward-model discrepancy require calibration on independent mocks
CF4 group-member covariance and shared-redshift source-resolution contract is incomplete
immutable declared k-bin manifest and SHA256 binding are absent
